title: Bpic19PreparedRuns
description: Closed public declared-measurement review/native-run/read/export boundary. Assessment items are independent of any original-source context. No raw population or caller-supplied norms, deviations, layer weights or scores are admitted.

DeclaredOriginalRowReference.description: An unverified declaration only; never manufacture or load a source row to satisfy it.

Provenance.description: Provenance is declared, never verified by this contract. Assessment references must name rows in this artifact and include the owning row. Original references may be empty and assert neither source presence nor a raw witness. Array order is part of content identity.

Measurement.description: An available numeric zero is evidence distinct from unavailable. Numbers must be finite JSON numbers; booleans, NaN and Infinity are forbidden. Availability is independent of flow applicability; no cross-cell physical history consistency is asserted.

c_l1_invoice_present.description: Invoice evidence should exist for invoice-bearing flows.

c_l1_clear_invoice_present.description: Invoice-bearing flows should eventually be cleared.

c_l1_goods_or_ses_present.description: 3-way flows should contain goods or service receipt evidence.

c_l2_df1_invoice_after_goods.description: In DF1, invoice evidence should not precede the first goods/service event.

c_l2_df2_release_after_goods.description: In DF2, payment-block release should happen after the first goods/service event.

c_l2_2way_no_goods_expected.description: 2-way match should not show goods/service receipt postings.

c_l2_consignment_no_clear_invoice.description: Consignment should normally not be settled through standard Clear Invoice in this log scope.

c_l3_df1_goods_to_invoice_days.description: In DF1, invoice should follow goods/service within a target time.

c_l3_invoice_to_clear_days.description: Invoice-bearing flows should clear in a reasonable time.

c_l3_df2_goods_to_rpb_days.description: In DF2, goods/service to Remove Payment Block should be timely.

c_l3_df2_rpb_to_clear_days.description: In DF2, released items should clear quickly.

c_l4_goods_fragmentation.description: Too many goods/service receipt events indicate fragmentation.

c_l4_repeated_invoice_receipt.description: Repeated invoice receipt events indicate invoice handling churn.

c_l4_change_payment_terms_repeats.description: Repeated payment-term changes indicate unstable commercial handling.

c_l5_cancel_invoice_receipt.description: Invoice receipt cancellations should be exceptional.

c_l5_cancel_goods_receipt.description: Goods receipt cancellations should be exceptional.

c_l5_delete_item.description: PO item deletion should be exceptional once execution is underway.

c_l5_debit_memo.description: Vendor debit memos should be rare.

c_l5_credit_memo.description: Vendor credit memos should be rare.

c_l6_change_price.description: Price changes after ordering indicate commercial inconsistency risk.

c_l6_change_quantity.description: Quantity changes after ordering indicate commercial inconsistency risk.

c_l6_high_exposure_memo.description: Correction documents on high-exposure cases matter more financially.

c_l6_high_exposure_price_change.description: Price changes on high-exposure cases are financially more critical.

c_l7_manual_touches.description: Too many manual touches reduce touchless processing potential.

c_l7_distinct_human_resources.description: Too many human handoffs indicate coordination cost.

c_l7_total_events.description: Very long event chains indicate execution friction.

c_l7_manual_share.description: High manual share indicates low straight-through processing.

c_l6_bal_networth_volatility.description: Large swings in cumulative net worth across events indicate commercial inconsistency (paper: balance constraint pattern, Table V c3/c4).

catalogue_sha256.description: Immutable upstream historical29 catalogue authority for prepared-v1 declarations; not the digest of a distribution copy. The separately verified distribution omits only the unused private source default. Native norm metadata reports its actual packaged digest, upstream digest and named adaptation; see docs/prepared-catalogue-provenance.md.

rows.description: Declared assessment order is meaningful and hashed. These are not original event rows.

content_id.description: preparation.content_identity convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact sorted-key JSON, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, excluding content_id and presentation only. All declared array orders and provenance enter the hash.

presentation.description: Optional display-only permutation of item identities; excluded from content identity. JSON object field ordering is also immaterial.
